summary: This RFC specifies how clients get notified about changes in a centralized conference (XCON). It reuses the SIP event package for conference state and adds support for the XCON data model and for partial notifications that report only what changed.

eli5.summary: When something changes in a meeting, people who care get a short message. This sets out how that message is sent, including small messages that only say what is new instead of repeating everything.

questions: sip conference event package xcon extension
